mapper.select: SELECT cart.*,good_standard.price,good.imgs,`name`,store, (good.uid) as seller FROM cart,good_standard,good WHERE cart.gid = good.gid AND cart.gid = good_standard.gid AND cart.standard = good_standard.`value` AND cart.uid = #{uid} ORDER BY cart.create_time DESC
